items.title: What does APEC's innovation priority look like on the ground in Shenzhen?
items.description: What does innovation — one of APEC's three priorities this year — look like in practice? In Huaqiangbei, Shenzhen, it starts with an idea and finding the people who can help build it. Components, technical expertise and engineers come together here, giving makers from around the world a place to turn ideas into products.
